text: The CSF analysis shows normal glucose and protein levels with a normal cell count, and your MRI is unremarkable, which effectively rules out meningitis and most bacterial causes. text: The normal inflammatory markers from your ANA and ESR tests help rule out an autoimmune cause like lupus. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS). Your presentation of fever, altered mentation, generalized rigidity, and profuse sweating in the context of taking haloperidol is classic for this condition.
